title: Greenhollow
summary: A hedge-village at the edge of the Thornway woods has lost two flocks and a shepherd to something that came out of the trees. The village cannot pay for soldiers, only a hot meal, a warm bed, and whatever coin the collection plate holds.

seed_character.name: Rosalind Thorn
seed_character.background: A farmhand turned militia spear-carrier after the second flock went missing; she knows the Thornway paths better than the woods deserve, and owes the innkeeper for two winters of unpaid board.
seed_character.appearance: Broad-shouldered and sun-browned, with a mended leather jerkin and a spear she carries like a walking stick until she does not.
